subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should channels without native album metadata, starting with LINE, get opt-in same-sender media batching, a broader shared channel batching contract, or no heuristic batching support?
rationale: LINE has no current OpenClaw batching surface, and choosing a delay/key/default changes user-visible turn boundaries and public config semantics.

options.title: Add LINE opt-in batching
options.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin config key and batch only same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

options.title: Design shared contract first
options.body: Define a generic channel/SDK batching seam before changing LINE, accepting broader architecture and compatibility review.

options.title: Keep unsupported
options.body: Keep native Telegram album buffering only and document that metadata-free channels dispatch media events individually.

recommendation.title: Add LINE opt-in batching
recommendation.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin config key and batch only same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a shared inbound/config product choice, and this handle has relevant shared debounce and config-boundary history.
